title: situation.s13_buell_relief.title

gate.none: Proposed for review: this paper concerns military command, administration or finance; it contains no policy toward a protected population, security order or atrocity consequence.

citations.at: I-16 part II pp. 641–642; General Orders No. 168 and Halleck’s enclosed order to Buell, 24 October 1862. The separate supply instructions on p. 641 are not adopted as a policy facet here.

namedOnly: Names of addressees, the subjects of allegations or custody, and prospective appointees identify the dated document’s participants; they do not assert that those people hold a post now. Speakers lists the rostered people whose words or official acts are given. Unrostered document authors need the identities and posts recorded in the index before promotion.
